title: Future forms
intro: Read this before the questions on the future.

blocks.title: ways to talk about the future
items: **will + base verb:** a decision now, a prediction or a promise: I **will help** you.
**be going to + base verb:** a plan, or something we can see is about to happen: Look at the clouds! It **is going to rain**.
**present continuous:** a fixed arrangement: I **am meeting** Sam at five.
**present simple:** a timetable: The train **leaves** at nine.

blocks.title: future continuous and future perfect
items: **Future continuous:** will be + verb-ing: At eight tomorrow I **will be studying**.
**Future perfect:** will have + past participle: By June she **will have finished** her degree.

blocks.title: the big trap
items: After **if, when, as soon as, before, until, after**, use the PRESENT for the future: I will call you when I **arrive** (not *when I will arrive*).
will is followed by the base verb: She will **go** (not *will goes*, not *will going*).
